newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire rises on share buyback news.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire rises on share buyback news.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Water Plc jumped to their highest level in almost seven months after the company announced a capital reorganisation and a plan to return up to 10 percent of the company to shareholders as cash.
By 0856 GMT, the shares were up 12-1/2p at 730.
The shares have been steadily rising for the past three months on expectations of of a share buyback, analysts said.
The terms, while more complex than many had anticipated, were broadly better than expected, said Nigel Hawkins, a utility analyst with Yamaichi.
"It appears to be a sensibile deal and certainly innovative," Hawkins said. "People have been waiting for months for some sort of share buyback."
Hawkins said he expects to more share buybacks in the sector in the future.
